jamal: Quick heads-up 5252 staging pen-test dry run next Tue 09:00 PT. Need ops lead, uploader, and a tight evidence escrow flow (no DB dumps).
emily: +1. We need a tiny manifest: object, sha256, kms_key_arn, presign_ttl, grant_arn, uploader, signature. Keep it machine-parseable.
tanya: I can ops lead. Ops will produce 1h rolling slices and a focused 24h slice for any flagged endpoints. I'll run sanitization (redact PII, obfuscate IPs to /24) at T-30.
mike: I'll script the upload. Plan: create per-bundle DEK, wrap with CMK using EncryptionContext {"pt-bundle":"<id>"}, create a time-bound KMS Grant constrained to that context, upload bundle, write manifest and KMS-sign it, then presign the object for 1h.
kms-bot: KMS tip: use create-grant with EncryptionContextSubset to limit Decrypt scope. Example: `aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/staging-logs --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-auditor --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"pt-bundle":"b123"}`. Revoke grant after window.
emily: Add checklist: manifest.sha256, manifest.signature (KMS-signed), grant ARN, presign TTL, assr contact, and security sign-off on sanitized sample.
jamal: Retest: prefer 10 business days after remediation. If fix increases privileges, freeze deploys for the service and escalate to #incidents.
tanya: I'll approve sanitized sample at 08:30 PT and won't hand off until security signs off.
mike: Upload will run tonight; will post presign + grant ARN here when done.
